title: Talking to AI: a good prompt
goal: A clear prompt = Task + Context + Format. Vague in, vague out.

blocks.title: Vague in, vague out
blocks.body:
It's 9pm. You type "make a worksheet" and get something useless.

The problem isn't the AI — it's the instructions. Let's fix that in one line.

blocks.title: The recipe: Task + Context + Format
blocks.body:
A good prompt has three parts:

• Task — what you want ("write 5 quiz questions")
• Context — about your class ("Grade 6 Science, the water cycle")
• Format — how it should look ("multiple choice, with an answer key")

Give it all three and you'll rarely need a second try.

blocks.prompt: Build a strong prompt — tap the pieces in order: Task, then Context, then Format.

items.text: …for a Grade 6 Science class on the water cycle…

blocks.question: How confident do you feel writing a clear prompt now?
